program: BLOBS patchworlds — PoU world composition, first basic tests

conventions.engine: patch_lib.run_patched: map-aware fork of l0/stage2/lib/genome.py run_genome (IMEX-FFT dt=0.02 dx=0.5); spatially-varying D = min-base implicit FFT + conservative explicit div(dD grad f)
conventions.grid: N=192 px, dx=0.5 -> L=96 length-units; ALL user-facing distances in px (1 unit = 2 px)
conventions.rho: rho_B(x)=0.5*(tanh((x-x_lo)/w)+tanh((x_hi-x)/w)); band [48,144)px -> seams at 48 and 144 px; w quoted in px (w_len=w_px*dx); 10-90% ramp = 2.2w
conventions.blend: theta(x) = theta_A + rho_B*(theta_B-theta_A) per param; maps only for params that differ
conventions.worlds: A=ref_M0 (A=tau*Dv=3, static blob); B=ref_M4(tau) A=4 family (tau=5.8 traveling single, single onset 5.748); non-aligned vacua via k1_orig shift
conventions.seeding: M0 static: G.poke u-bump amp2 sig3; M4 traveler: A4 stamp paste, kick=(angle,kick_px) v,w displaced opposite (composite convention)
conventions.metrics: tracking = genome.py Tracker (periodic label, circ-mean centroid, greedy identity); positions unwrapped, reported in px

gate: bit-identity of fields+series across ref/scalar/forcemap paths
